Proof of delivery (packing slip or delivery confirmation) and equipment serial numbers are also required.

Bid Summary.value: The State of Maryland Treasurer's Office is seeking Dell Laptops w/Extended Warranty under bid E20P4600040, consisting of 30 Dell Latitude 5550 laptops (SI# CC7802) and 30 Dell Thunderbolt 4 docks (WD22TB4), with the Dell Limited Hardware Warranty extended 3 years. Bids are due 2024-06-10 14:00 EDT and must be submitted electronically only through eMaryland Marketplace Advantage (eMMA); email, fax, U.S. Mail and hand delivery are not accepted. Only Master Contractors awarded under the Desktop, Laptop and Tablet 2015 Master Contract 060B5400007 may bid, and they must be authorized Dell resellers, with a Letter of Authorization possible on request. Each laptop must have an Intel Core Ultra 5 125U, 16 GB DDR5 RAM, 256 GB NVMe SSD, a 15.6" FHD non-touch display and Windows 11 Pro, and must be Microsoft Copilot ready. Delivery is required within 45 days of award, a Mercury Affidavit and warranty certificate or affidavit are required, and invoices must be submitted within 10 days of delivery. The contact is Tamaira Hawkins, 410-260-7533, thawkins@treasurer.state.md.us; the term of bid, pre-bid meeting, installation and bid bond requirements were not found.

warnings: judge (partial): The cited text supports the emailed invoices, 10-day submission window, required invoice contents, and proof of delivery, but it does not mention equipment serial numbers as part of the invoice content beyond proof of delivery and does not state payment terms themselves, which the value presents as answering the question.

judge (partial): The cited SKU table supports the CPU, RAM, SSD, display, Windows 11 Pro, 54 Wh battery, 65W adapter, and ENERGY STAR, and the scope cites the Copilot-ready requirement and 3-year warranty, but the value's 'Dell Latitude 5550' model naming and warranty wording are only partly tied to the cited text, and the Copilot requirement is stated as needed rather than fully confirmed as a spec in the table.
